pages.title: Fengyuan Clans
pages.text: This entry follows patchouli_static_entries.json#human_clan_league, human_clan_league.json, and human_clan_quest_network.json. The current version uses the existing spirit_fengyuan region as the visible home of the clan league.

pages.title: Four Specializations
pages.text: The Fengyuan clans are divided by specialty: the Mo Clan favors formations, the Yu Clan artifact refinement, the Gu Clan alchemy, and the Ning Clan talismans. The Ye Clan of Great Jin and Marquis Nanlong's clan also remain in the league corpus as future cross-region hooks.

pages.title: Quest Network
pages.text: human_clan_quest_network.json defines clan introductions, the Mo formation route, Yu refinement route, Gu alchemy route, and Ning talisman route, and reserves dajin_clan_feud_mirror_fengyuan as an inter-clan event. Actual quests and reputation are not yet integrated.

pages.title: Planned Content
pages.text: Clan NPCs, clan reputation, outsider alliances or marriage requirements, specialty shops, commissions, clan disputes, the Great Jin mirror event, and an FTB Quests chapter are not yet implemented. This page describes only the existing corpus and Fengyuan hooks.
